asr.text: Tell me about yourself. Sure. Um. So I'm a third -year computer science student at the University of Toronto. Last summer I interned at a Fintech startup where I, uh, built the data pipeline for their fraud detection system. The pipeline processed about 2 million transactions a day, and I reduced the end -to -end latency from 40 seconds to under 5. I'm drawn to this role because, you know, I really enjoy working on systems where performance actually matters to the user.
